CPI(M) Initiates Organisational Overhaul in Kerala Post-Election

The Communist Party of India (Marxist) has commenced a significant organisational revamp in Kerala following its defeat in recent elections. This internal cleanup aims to address shortcomings and strengthen the party's structure in the state. The initiative involves a comprehensive review of party functioning and strategies.
